name: logo
description: Brand mark — single solid silhouette, structured brief format
prefix:
LOGO BRIEF — render the following concept as a single brand mark.

NEGATIVE SPACE:
- Use one internal cut or curvature to create a distinctive inner contour
- The negative space enhances recognition, not complexity

PROPORTIONS:
- Slightly top-heavy with a strong downward taper into a sharp or semi-sharp base
- Optically balanced (visually centered, not mathematically centered)

DETAILING:
- Solid filled shape only — no outlines, no strokes, no internal lines
- No typography, no extra symbols, no text
- No copyright marks, watermarks, or additional elements

COMPOSITION:
- Centered on canvas
- Large scale with generous breathing space around the mark
- Designed to work as a standalone brand mark and app icon

QUALITY CONTROL:
- Must remain recognizable at favicon size (16px)
- Avoid overcomplication — simplicity with character
- Prioritize silhouette memorability over decorative detail

OUTPUT:
- Crisp vector-style logo
- High contrast, razor-sharp edges

CONCEPT
suffix: Render the mark only, on a pure white background. Single mark, no variants in this image
